description:
The top models on one category's board. category is one of overall, coding, agentic, reasoning, math, knowledge, design
        (see list_categories). limit is 1 to 50. overall is the LLMBenchmark Index: a weighted mean of the Vibe Coding Index, the agentic, reasoning, math and knowledge indexes, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and the LMArena text Elo, with a 90% margin.
name: get_leaderboard
